# FDG3070

> CONSIDER giving a property the same name as its type.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.6.2 Names of Properties.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

For example, the following property correctly gets and sets an enum value named `Color`, so the property is named `Color`:

```csharp
public enum Color {...}
public class Control {
  public Color Color { get; set; }
}
```
